digest.component_or_area: review kernel and consumer pipelines (plan-review, code-review)
propositions: Contract-violation telemetry is only wired into plan_review pipeline but not code_review pipeline, creating inconsistent observability between the two consumers.
The shared ContextVar-backed contract violation sink in plan_review/orchestrator.py must be moved to review_kernel and imported by both pipelines to eliminate duplication.

Outcome counts (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) cannot be computed per-chunk at *_decide boundary because workflow engine merges all chunks before output reaches decision step, so only whole-run tallies are feasible.
A shared helper function decide_outcome_counts must be added to review_kernel to compute single-run outcome counts deterministically from merged verifications and reshape state.
Both plan_review_decide and code_review_decide must call the shared outcome_counts helper and emit results in their output dicts for coverage tracking.

Code-review pipeline must activate contract-violation collection in gate_dispatch._run_code_review_gate, record violations in code_review_decide when reshape.has_violations, and drain into finalize_code_review_verdict coverage.
